features.name: Supervisor Configuration Loading and Path Resolution
features.description: Loads configuration from config.json, resolving repo-relative paths for trigger_file, agents_file, runs_directory, and external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact with fallback defaults, ensuring neither Agents.md nor send-to-gemini.js divergently hardcodes external paths.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Reads config.json, asserts existence, and resolves triggerPath, agentsPath, runsRoot, and step3EvalPath using repoRoot.
Defines shared_configuration_contract mandating that all external references are resolved via ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json.

features.name: Run Nonce Validation
features.description: Validates that a run nonce string contains strictly alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens, throwing an error if invalid.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Tests input against /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/ and throws Error('Invalid run_nonce') if check fails.

features.name: Step Heading Parsing and Extraction
features.description: Parses step numbers from Agents.md markdown headings and extracts isolated step specification text blocks between markdown step boundaries.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Scans Agents.md for /^## Step\s+(\d+)\s*$/gm, returns unique sorted array of numeric step IDs, or throws if empty.
Locates the heading for a specific step and extracts the markdown block up to the subsequent step heading or EOF.

features.name: Step-Specific Context Resolution
features.description: Determines the list of required context files for evaluation based on the active step number, appending the Step 3 evaluation artifact path when executing Step 3.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Returns ['Agents.md', relStep3Artifact] for Step 3, and ['Agents.md'] for all other steps.

features.name: Canonical Step 3 Evaluation Artifact Loader
features.description: Loads and structurally verifies the Step 3 evaluation artifact, enforcing that evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr question corpora are present in a single JSON document without tracking document reads.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Verifies step3EvalPath existence and checks for evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr top-level keys.
step_3_evaluation_artifact_is_canonical contract specifies the artifact contains the heuristic and complete Step3_TSR question corpus without separate read-tracking fields.

features.name: Run Lifecycle Initialization and State Synchronization
features.description: Initializes run state, messages, and store files for a run nonce or restores existing run artifacts while validating nonce uniformity and updating remaining/current steps and awaiting statuses.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Creates state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json if not present with initial status 'awaiting_chatgpt_execution'; otherwise loads existing files, enforces matching run_nonce across all three, and reconciles procedure.current_step, procedure.remaining_steps, and procedure.awaiting.

features.name: Run Message and Store Record Persistence
features.description: Provides persistent append-only records for conversational interaction messages and audit store records with timestamp and record ID generation.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Pushes new entry into messages.contents and writes updated JSON to messagesFile.
Appends a new store record with auto-generated record_id and ISO timestamp into store.records and persists to storeFile.
Ensures parent directory existence with mkdirSync recursive and writes formatted JSON.

features.name: Execution Trigger and Role Provenance Inspection
features.description: Inspects incoming trigger payloads to ensure execution is controller-identified as originating from 'ChatGPT model', matches the active step, contains an execution object, and conforms to role control requirements.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Extracts rawExecution, verifies execution.source_role === 'ChatGPT model', checks execution.step is an integer matching step, verifies return_schema is an object, and collects validation failures.

Checks found control block for role_required === 'ChatGPT model', role_forbidden === 'Gemini model', role_completed === 'ChatGPT model', non-empty role_verification method/evidence, and return_schema_completed === true.

features.name: Step 0 through Step 2 Schema Structure Validation
features.description: Validates required objects, non-empty timestamp/nonce strings, and requirement string arrays for Step 0 (start_of_turn), Step 1 (step_1_record), and Step 2 (step_2_record).

evidence.mechanic_summary: Verifies start_of_turn fields for Step 0, step_1_record fields for Step 1, and step_2_record stated_requirements non-empty string array for Step 2.

features.name: Step 3 Schema, Decomposition, Modifier, and Loop Control Validation
features.description: Enforces complete decomposition schema for Step 3 (A-G blocks), requiring clause action/person/object arrays, modifier analysis with positive recursive levels, test count matching TSR question results length with 'T'/'F' values, and exact loop decision logic.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Enforces Step_3 object presence, required descriptor/instruction/value strings across sections A-G, clause array validation, modifier recursive_level integer validation, test_results count equivalence, and sets Loop_Decision to 'True' with return_to 'Step_3.A' if any test is 'T', or 'False' with return_to null if all tests are 'F'.
Specifies evaluation requirements including step_3_complete_U_decomposition, step_3_plan_satisfies_all_step_2_requirements, step_3_all_tests_are_evaluated (31 tests), and step_3_loop_control.

features.name: Step 4 Failures-First and Completion Evidence Validation
features.description: Enforces reporting sequence and schema for Step 4 requiring failed actions first, incomplete actions second, and verified completed actions last with non-empty completion evidence.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Validates Step_4 structure requiring failed_actions, not_completed_actions, and completed_actions arrays, checking action/failure/remaining_work/evidence on failures and incomplete actions, and action/completion === 'complete'/non-empty completion_evidence on completed actions.

Evaluation requirements step_4_failures_first, step_4_incomplete_second, step_4_live_ground_truth_completion, and step_4_all_requirements_accounted_for specify strict ordering and anti-deception rules.
Defines field-level definitions and pass/fail criteria for failed_actions, not_completed_actions, completed_actions, and control fields.

features.name: Deterministic Live Ground Truth Precedence and Gate Enforcement
features.description: Requires empirical runtime ground truth to be collected independently by the runtime before supervisory evaluation, making blocking ground truth statuses (CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, NOT_EXECUTED) block a PASS result.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines GT_STATUS set and BLOCKING_GT_STATUS set containing 'CONTRADICTED', 'PARTIAL', 'UNKNOWN', and 'NOT_EXECUTED'.
deterministic_live_ground_truth_precedes_semantic_pass mandates runtime inspection before Gemini supervision, ensuring findings are generated prior to supervision and blocking when material.
step_3_live_ground_truth requirement states material claims must be VERIFIED against runtime ground truth or accurately non-verified and not used as successful premises.
step_4_live_ground_truth_completion requires completion_evidence to correlate with immutable deterministic findings; self-reported evidence alone is insufficient.

features.name: Deterministic Ground Truth Persistence
features.description: Mandates that exact deterministic ground truth findings collected during evaluation attempts are persisted in procedure step_records and store records for auditable execution history.

evidence.mechanic_summary: ground_truth_findings_are_persisted specifies every attempt must persist deterministic findings in state step_records and store records.

features.name: Supervisory Gate Transition Control Semantics
features.description: Maintains deterministic procedure step transitions where supervisory_gate.gate_result = PASS advances procedure by one step and FAIL retries the identical step without bypass.

evidence.mechanic_summary: transition_semantics_are_unchanged specifies gate_result as the exact transition key where PASS advances one step and FAIL retries the same step.
step_4_terminal_integrity requires verified role, completed Step 4, and procedure termination only after Gemini PASS with no remaining steps.

features.name: Synchronous Git Subprocess Execution
features.description: Executes git CLI commands synchronously within repoRoot with stdout/stderr capture and buffer capping to inspect repository ground truth safely.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Invokes execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repoRoot, maxBuffer: 4 * 1024 * 1024 }) and returns { ok, stdout, error }.

features.name: Safe Workspace Path Resolution and Boundary Containment
features.description: Sanitizes candidate path strings, blocks null bytes, absolute paths, and directory traversal attempts, ensuring resolved paths remain strictly within repoRoot.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Replaces backslashes, checks for '\0' and isAbsolute, calculates relative path from repoRoot, and returns null if relative path escapes via '..'.

features.name: Repository Path and Git Commit SHA Extraction
features.description: Extracts recognized repository file paths and 40-character hexadecimal git commit hashes from unstructured text or locator strings.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Matches paths starting with ChatMachines, .github, tests, docs, src, or runs/ from text, mapping runs/ into ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs/.
Extracts 40-character hexadecimal string /\b[0-9a-f]{40}\b/i.
